name: Asana
description: A productivity and project management platform providing workspace task, project, and workflow automation via a comprehensive REST API and developer platform.

evidence.claim: The Asana API is a RESTful interface, providing programmatic access to much of the data in the system.
Asana offers a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows AI assistants and other applications to access the Asana Work Graph.
Your app may ultimately use OAuth, but most developers test our API by creating a Personal Access Token (PAT)

notes: Asana provides a very robust developer platform featuring a RESTful API, personal access tokens, OAuth2 support, webhooks, app components, and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
